:::{#sol-rss-deriv-intercept-in-means}

Write the derivative from @exr-rss-deriv-intercept
in terms of $\predbar$ and $\outbar$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial \text{RSS}}{\partial \intcoef}
&= -2 \sumin (\outvar_\iobs - \intcoef - \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs)
&& \text{(derivative of the RSS)}\\
&= -2 \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs - \sumin \intcoef - \sumin \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs}
&& \text{(distribute the sum over the terms)}\\
&= -2 \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs - n \intcoef - \sumin \coef{x} \predvar_\iobs}
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= -2 \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs - n \intcoef - \coef{x} \sumin \predvar_\iobs}
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= -2 \paren{n \outbar - n \intcoef - \coef{x} \sumin \predvar_\iobs}
&& \text{($\sumin \outvar_\iobs = n \outbar$)}\\
&= -2 \paren{n \outbar - n \intcoef - \coef{x} n \predbar}
&& \text{($\sumin \predvar_\iobs = n \predbar$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
